shared_elements: row of repeated motifs along the top edge
profile-facing creatures arranged in a file
justification: Both are stone reliefs organised in horizontal registers, with a repeated row of small motifs running along the upper edge and profile quadrupeds in file below, and each includes a branching plant/tree form. Beyond that generic scheme they differ profoundly: A is a smoothly finished, high-relief, naturalistic procession with human figures and precise ornamental borders, while B is a coarse, shallow, schematic array of animal shapes on a rough-hewn pillar with no human participants or framed ornament.
